body.purpose: Default application text with Traditional Chinese fallbacks.

key-legend.purpose: Captions inside the physical keyboard map.

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: A labeled destination in the eight-item workbench navigation.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; width:100%; min-height:44px; padding:10px 14px; color:#192231; background:transparent; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:9px; font:500 14px/1.5 'Segoe UI',sans-serif; text-align:left; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background:#DDE6F1; } .ds-nav-item[aria-current=page] { background:#DCE9FF; border-color:#CBD4E1; color:#124998; font-weight:700; } @media(max-width:760px) { .ds-nav-item { justify-content:center; gap:6px; min-height:38px; padding:7px 4px; font-size:12px; } .ds-nav-item svg { display:none; } }

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: A clear action control for committing a reviewed operation.
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height:38px; padding:8px 15px; border:1px solid #215CC5; border-radius:7px; background:#215CC5; color:#fff; font:600 14px/1.5 'Segoe UI',sans-serif; } .ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { filter:brightness(.94); } :focus-visible { outline:3px solid #1754B5; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Keyboard Key
components.description: A physical keycap whose fill distinguishes current selection from a staged edit.
components.css: .ds-key { padding:0; border:1px solid #CBD4E1; border-radius:5px; background:#fff; color:#192231; font:11px/1.25 'Segoe UI',sans-serif; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; } .ds-key-selected { background:#215CC5; border-color:#215CC5; color:#fff; } .ds-key-pending { background:#DCE9FF; color:#124998; border:2px solid #1754B5; } :root[data-theme=dark] .ds-key { background:#131D2A; border-color:#45546A; color:#EDF2F8; } :root[data-theme=dark] .ds-key-selected { background:#8DBAFF; border-color:#8DBAFF; color:#111823; } :root[data-theme=dark] .ds-key-pending { background:#243D60; color:#C9DFFF; border-color:#8DBAFF; }

components.name: Workbench Card
components.description: An opaque bordered container for related device controls.
components.css: .ds-card { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:14px; padding:22px; border:1px solid #CBD4E1; border-radius:12px; background:#fff; } :root[data-theme=dark] .ds-card { border-color:#45546A; background:#1B2635; } @media(max-width:760px) { .ds-card { padding:16px; } }

components.name: Theme Selector
components.description: A labeled system, light, or dark appearance choice stored locally.
components.html: <label for="theme-choice">介面主題</label><select id="theme-choice"><option>跟隨 Windows</option><option>淺色</option><option>深色</option></select>
components.css: select { min-height:38px; min-width:0; padding:7px 10px; border:1px solid #CBD4E1; border-radius:7px; background:#fff; color:#192231; font:13px 'Segoe UI',sans-serif; } :root[data-theme=dark] select { border-color:#45546A; background:#131D2A; color:#EDF2F8; } :focus-visible { outline:3px solid #1754B5; outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview: A quiet neutral Windows workbench for configuring a physical B87 keyboard. Graphite text and opaque tonal surfaces keep the device map and controls legible; blue distinguishes selection and action states. Traditional Chinese labels are concise and operational. The native shell keeps its caption controls in a separate 36px strip. The work area follows Windows theme by default, with a persisted local system, light, or dark choice.
keyCharacteristics: Opaque neutral work surfaces with blue state color
Windows UI sans typography with Traditional Chinese fallbacks
Physical keyboard map and adjacent editing controls remain central

rules.name: The Opaque Surface Rule
rules.body: Every app surface declares a solid theme color so native window composition cannot wash out interface text.

rules.name: The State Color Rule
rules.body: Blue marks active selection, focus, and primary action; the pale selected wash distinguishes staged mapping changes.

dos: Do keep all app regions opaque and use the matching light or dark token set.
Do keep all eight navigation labels visible, including in the compact grid.
Do distinguish selected keys from staged edits with the established state colors.
Do preserve the separate native caption strip and visible keyboard focus.
donts: Don't imply keyboard mapping from the knob's location; it opens key testing.
Don't introduce translucent app surfaces that compromise text legibility.
Don't replace the neutral workbench with decorative marketing panels.
